sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner files the certified copy of the statement of solemn affirmation of the complainant.
Keep the same in the record.

4. The allegation is that the co-accused nos.1 to 4 named in the complaint have sold the property of the complainant to the petitioner; by showing them as descendants of the grandfather of the complainant and thereafter the petitioner has got the said land mutated in her name and is possessing the same.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the allegation against the petitioner is false and there is no allegation against the petitioner that she was aware that her vendors were not the real owners and the complainant was the owner of the land which her vendors sold to her.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that prior to this case, Complaint Case No.1297 of 2015 was filed by the complainant which was sent to Doranda police station for institution of the FIR under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. and consequent upon which Doranda P.S. Case No 396 of 2015 was registered and police after due investigation submitted final form as the dispute is a civil dispute and after that this protest petition has been filed and on the basis of same, the learned Sub- Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi has taken cognizance.

Hence, it is submitted that the entire criminal proceeding of Complaint Case No. 4211 of 2018 including the order taking cognizance dated 22.08.2019 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi be quashed and set aside.

6. Learned Special Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 on the other hand opposes the prayer for quashing the entire criminal proceeding of Complaint Case No.
4211 of 2018 including the order taking cognizance dated 22.08.2019 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 that since the petitioner is in possession of the land in question hence, she is squarely responsible for cheating the complainant.
Hence, it is submitted that this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit be dismissed.

7. Having heard the submissions made at the Bar and after going through the materials in the record, it is pertinent to mention here that it is a settled principle of law as has been held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Md. Ibrahim vs. State of Bihar reported in (2009) 6 SCC 477 that in a case of cheating of a vendee by the vendor of the sale deed, it is the vendee who can institute a case of cheating against the vendor but not a third person.

entities.text: Md. Ibrahim vs. State of Bihar reported in (2009) 6 SCC 477
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Now coming to the facts of the case, there is no allegation against the petitioner of having ever dishonestly induced the complainant or anyone else to deliver any property or valuable to the petitioner.
There is no allegation that the petitioner was aware that her vendors were not the real owners.
This is a case where the vendors of the petitioner are claiming to be the true owner of the property.

sentences.text: Under such circumstance, this Court has no hesitation in holding that even if the allegations made in the complaint, statement of the complainant under solemn affirmation and the other materials available in the record are treated to be true in its entirety, still, the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of Indian Penal Code is not made out against the petitioner.

Hence, the entire criminal proceeding of Complaint Case No. 4211 of 2018 including the order taking cognizance dated 22.08.2019 passed by the learned Sub- Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi be quashed and set aside qua the petitioner only.

10. Accordingly, entire criminal proceeding of Complaint Case No. 4211 of 2018 including the order taking cognizance dated 22.08.2019 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate,
Ranchi is quashed and set aside qua the petitioner only.
11. In the result, this criminal miscellaneous petition is allowed to the aforesaid extent.

8. Now coming to the facts of the case, there is no allegation against the petitioner of having ever dishonestly induced the complainant or anyone else to deliver any property or valuable to the petitioner.
